note: Walked connect validation errors, parent/mountpoint errors, name and alias errors, mounts list/status, docs and mobile docs. Persist success, Finder row, drop-file and reboot restore are not-walkable (no Instabox, no Finder app).

findings.description: Run `mounts add coordinator <mp> --sandbox m_7f3a1234` (--help lists: mounts add NAME MOUNTPOINT [--drive ID] [--api URL] [--read-only] [--sandbox ID]).
findings.expected: Registers a live workspace, or help does not list --sandbox for mounts add.
findings.actual: "A --drive ID is required. No drive key is configured for this API." With --root: "--root is only supported by `connect`." So `mounts add` cannot register a live workspace although --help shows --sandbox on it.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove --sandbox from the mounts add help line, or accept --root; tell the user to use `connect`.

findings.description: mkdir the whole mountpoint, then run `connect ... --persist`.
findings.expected: Message says the mountpoint must not exist yet (remove the empty folder); docs say the same.
findings.actual: "Finder mountpoint already exists: /Users/agent/uxw/m055/AgentWorkspaces/coordinator" with no instruction; docs only show mkdir of the parent and never state that the mountpoint must be absent (Linux docs say an existing empty directory is required).
findings.suggested_fix: Append 'Remove the empty folder and rerun' to the message and add one docs sentence.

findings.description: Read docs 'Live workspace mounts' and try `--sandbox my-sandbox`.
findings.expected: Docs explain what an Instabox sandbox is and where to find its m_... ID.
findings.actual: Docs use the placeholder SANDBOX_ID only. The CLI error "Invalid Instabox sandbox ID; use its exact m_... ID, not a name or alias." is clear but nothing says where the ID comes from. /docs/sandboxes has no mention of connect or Instabox.
findings.suggested_fix: Write 'm_...' in the example and say where the ID is shown.

findings.criterion: docs command index table clipped on mobile
findings.description: Open /docs/cli at 390x844 and scroll to the command index.
findings.expected: Table scrolls with a visible cue or reflows.
findings.actual: The Purpose column is cut at the right edge ("Upload a folder (upload-c", "Back up the API key and") with no scroll cue. pageOverflowX is 0, so the clipping is inside the table.
findings.suggested_fix: Reflow into stacked rows below 600px or add an overflow hint.
